gloss_en: grasping/holding fast to the aspect of 'the word of Hashem' (devar Hashem), which is the aspect of prayer (tefillah) — the practice of cleaving to divine speech through prayer (Likutey Moharan II:1), which enables healing through all things, even bread and water
canonical_he: כשאוחזין בבחינת דבר ה, בחינת תפלה
